amendment.reason: Existing Opportunity decision multipliers were tuned on March2025 labels, which are unavailable at December2024.
amendment.amendment: December Opportunity metrics use uniform multipliers (untuned argmax), for baseline and candidate. No model predictions or data change. June/September retain frozen multipliers.
amendment.initial_december_metric_status: Superseded diagnostic using later-tuned multipliers; must not be presented as a causal December backtest.
amendment.acceptance: Same numerical gates and no-December-deterioration guard; apply using corrected December Opportunity scoring. Correction declared before candidate fitting, not a retrospective gate relaxation.
amendment.implementation: Result finalization will preserve raw stage files and write corrected baseline/calendar comparison and decision files.
